#####STEP_1

###1-LOAD THE DATA

```{r}
#######load data
MS = read.csv("../../tomas.gomes/processed.data/autoimm_scrna_TomasGuerreiro/Datasets/Multiple Sclerosis/GSE180759_expression_matrix.csv/GSE180759_expression_matrix.csv")

```


###2-CREATE SEURAT_OBJ

```{r}
##convert to matrix using sparse matrix that store non zero_values
MS_matrix  = as ( MS, "sparseMatrix")

##seurat_obj
MS_obj = CreateSeuratObject(MS_matrix, project = "MS")
##save the raw_file 
saveRDS(MS_obj, file = "data/process/SeuratObjects/Multiple_Sclerosis/MS_raw.rds")

```


####STEP_2:PROCESS AND ANALYSE THE RAW_FILE

###1-FOR THE QC

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
#####
getwd()
MS_obj = readRDS("data/process/SeuratObjects/Multiple_Sclerosis/MS_raw.rds")
## THE QC for the cutoff to use
MS_obj[["percent.mt"]] = PercentageFeatureSet(MS_obj ,pattern = "^MT-")
VlnPlot(MS_obj, features = c("nFeature_RNA","nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),ncol = 3, log = TRUE)

### to detect abnormal cells 
plot1=FeatureScatter(MS_obj, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
plot2 = FeatureScatter(MS_obj,feature1 = "nCount_RNA" , feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
plot1 + plot2
ElbowPlot(MS_obj ,ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")
```

###2-Statistics

```{r}
#Normalize,fvf,pca,scale
MS_obj=NormalizeData(MS_obj)
MS_obj=FindVariableFeatures(MS_obj)
MS_obj=ScaleData(MS_obj, vars.to.regress = c("nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),features = VariableFeatures(object = MS_obj))
MS_obj=RunPCA(MS_obj,features = VariableFeatures(object = MS_obj))
MS_obj=RunUMAP(MS_obj,dims = 1:30)
p=DimPlot(MS_obj, reduction = "umap",label = TRUE)
ggsave(filename = "output/Multiple_Sclerosis/MSUmap.png", plot=p, width = 12, height = 8)

#ELBOW_plot for the threshol of the clusters and neighboor
ElbowPlot(MS_obj,ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")

#for the resolution
MS_obj=FindNeighbors(MS_obj,dims = 1:30)
for (res in seq(0.2, 1, by = 0.1)) {
  MS_obj <- FindClusters(MS_obj, resolution = res)
  colname <- paste0("res_", res)
  MS_obj[[colname]] <- MS_obj$seurat_clusters
}
res_cols <- grep("^res_", colnames(MS_obj@meta.data), value = TRUE)
for (res in res_cols) {
  p <- DimPlot(MS_obj, group.by = res, label = TRUE, reduction = "umap") +
       ggtitle(paste("Resolution:", res))
  print(p)
  readline(prompt="Press [Enter] to see the next resolution...")
}

#save 
p_res03=DimPlot(MS_obj,group.by = "res_0.3",label = TRUE,reduction = "umap" )+ ggtitle("Resolution: 0.3")
ggsave(filename = "output/Multiple_Sclerosis/MSresolution.png",plot = p_res03,width = 12,height = 8,dpi = 300)

```




###3-clusters and find all markers
```{r}
##cluster......
MS_obj=FindNeighbors(MS_obj,reduction ="pca",dims = 1:30)
MS_obj=FindClusters(MS_obj, resolution = 0.3)
##markers, apply the filtering and save
MS_markers=FindAllMarkers(MS_obj,only.pos = TRUE,min.pct = 0.25,logfc.threshold = 0.25)
MS_markers=MS_markers %>% filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.25)
write.xlsx(MS_markers,file = "output/Multiple_Sclerosis/MS_markers.xlsx")

```

###5-proportion
```{r}
###-------cell proportion

 prop_df=MS_obj@meta.data |>
  as_tibble() |>
  dplyr::count(celltype) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    proportion = n / sum(n),
    percent = proportion * 100
  )

prop_df$celltype=factor(
  prop_df$celltype,
  levels = prop_df$celltype[order(prop_df$proportion, decreasing = TRUE)]
)

fig1c = ggplot(prop_df, aes(x = celltype, y = proportion, fill = celltype)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(round(percent, 1), "%")),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_cols) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  ylab("Cell proportion") +
  xlab("")
fig1c
ggsave(filename = "output/Multiple_Sclerosis/MSproportion.png", plot = fig1c, width = 12, height = 8)

```



```{r}

##correlation between celltype
#1 Set identities to cell types
Idents(MS_obj) = "celltype"

#to see cellname
levels(Idents(MS_obj))


#2 Identify highly variable genes
MS_obj = FindVariableFeatures(MS_obj, nfeatures = 10000)
hvg = VariableFeatures(MS_obj)[1:5000]

#3 Average expression using HVGs
av_expMS = AverageExpression(
  MS_obj,
  features = hvg,
  assays = "RNA",
  slot = "data"
)$RNA

#4 Cell-type correlation matrix (Spearman)
correlation_matrix <- cor(
  as.matrix(av_expMS),
  method = "spearman",
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)

# safety cleanup
correlation_matrix[is.na(correlation_matrix)] = 0

#5 Save 
png(
  filename = "output/Multiple_Sclerosis/MS_celltype_corr.png",
  width = 3000,
  height = 2400,
  res = 300
)
library(pheatmap)
colors=colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(100)
pheatmap(
  correlation_matrix,
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  color = colors,
  fontsize_row = 9,
  fontsize_col = 9
)

dev.off()
```








###-Save the clean meta.data wtih all the final information
```{r}
#create a file with the raw_count,processed, the metadata and the active_id
##check the information

MS_obj$orig.ident="Multiple Sclerosis"


# Remove column i don't want to keep
cols_to_remove <- c(
  grep("res_|RNA_snn_res", colnames(MS_obj@meta.data), value = TRUE),
  "cell_type"
)
MS_obj@meta.data <- MS_obj@meta.data[, !(colnames(MS_obj@meta.data) %in% cols_to_remove)]
###
MS_obj$celltype = Idents(MS_obj)
Idents(MS_obj)=MS_obj$celltype
saveRDS(MS_obj, file = "data/process/SeuratObjects/Multiple_Sclerosis/MS_Final.rds")
MS_obj= readRDS("data/process/SeuratObjects/Multiple_Sclerosis/MS_Final.rds")
# Optional CSV 
write.csv(MS_obj@meta.data, 
          file = "data/process/SeuratObjects/Multiple_Sclerosis//MS_Final.csv",
          row.names = TRUE)
View(MS_obj@meta.data)
```
